encoding: gain: per channel (linear R G B) the factor from the ground texture's linear colour to surface reflectance; the client multiplies the ground and the herb layer's albedo by it (by its luminance, gain_luminance, by default); saturation: the chroma scale about the luminance (Rec. 601) that the client applies with the luminance factor
method: sum of the reference month's L2A reflectance over the sum of the texture's linear colour, open ground (tree < 10 %, shrub < 15 %, not water or built), 20 m
